_readme: Copy this file to config/providers.json and edit it. That copy is gitignored.
A key is NEVER written here. A profile names the environment variable that
holds it (apiKeyEnv), and the build reads the variable from your shell.
A config containing a literal apiKey/token/secret is rejected on load.
built-in shape defaults -> the profile below -> environment -> CLI flags
Pick a profile per run:   python src/build_course.py --audio in.mp3 --profile ollama
Or override any field:    ... --kind openai-compat --base-url URL --model NAME
See what is defined:      python src/build_course.py --list-profiles
The model names below are EXAMPLES in a file you own, not defaults in the code.
Change them freely; the pipeline never supplies one for you.
_asrLanguageProfiles_readme: 语言 → ASR profile。给了 --language 就自动选对应的转写模型，
显式 --asr-profile 仍然优先。--language auto 不路由：
音频没读之前语言是未知的，拿日语模型去转英语比慢更糟。

openai.description: Any OpenAI chat model. Set the model to whatever your account can call.

anthropic.description: Claude via the Messages API. Model ids change; set the one you want.

openrouter.description: One key, many vendors. The model string carries the vendor prefix.

ollama.description: Local model over Ollama's native API. No key, nothing leaves the machine.

ollama-openai.description: The same Ollama server through its OpenAI-compatible shim.

lmstudio.description: LM Studio's local server. The model is whatever you loaded in the UI.

llamacpp.description: llama.cpp llama-server. It ignores the model field but one must be set.

vllm.description: vLLM's OpenAI server. The model must match --served-model-name.

claude-cli.description: A subscription seat used as the API: Claude Code answers on stdout. Verify the flags against your installed version.

custom-cli.description: Any command that reads a prompt on stdin and prints the answer. Use {prompt_file} instead if your tool wants a file path.

manual.description: No API at all. The build writes *.prompt.txt here; you paste each into any chat window and save the reply as the matching *.reply.json, then re-run with --resume.

echo.description: Offline stub for tests and scaffolding. Writes visible placeholders and cannot be packaged without --allow-stub-enrichment.

japanese-accurate.description: 日语·精度优先（默认）。实测：与经 5 轮人工修补的 N2 课程一致率 93.9%，kotoba 只有 57.5%；字数多 19%，时间轴覆盖多 4.4 个百分点。慢，但这是为精度付的钱。

english-accurate.description: 英语·精度优先（默认）。同样是 large-v3，语言锁定 en。注意：英语侧我没有实测数据，这里沿用日语侧验证过的解码策略。

japanese-fast.description: 日语·速度优先。kotoba-whisper 快 4 倍以上，但实测在 N2 音频上漏掉 19% 的字、26 个段短于 0.35 秒、20 个段语速物理不可能，且换个 beam size 自我一致率只有 44%。只适合出草稿或试跑，不要用它出成品。

english-fast.description: 英语·速度优先。distil-large-v3 只训英语，比 large-v3 快得多。蒸馏解码器的取舍与 kotoba 同类，英语侧我没有实测，出成品前请自己对比。

local-whisper-cpu.description: Runs anywhere. Slower, but needs no GPU. Larger model = better text.

local-whisper-cuda.description: 通用兜底：语言未知或没有专用模型时用 large-v3。时间戳是三者里最稳的，慢也慢在这上面。

openai-whisper.description: Hosted transcription. Must support response_format=verbose_json with segment timestamps.

groq-whisper.description: Hosted Whisper, usually much faster than local CPU.

local-whisper-server.description: A local server imitating the audio API (faster-whisper-server, whisper.cpp server, LocalAI).

whisper-cpp.description: whisper.cpp writing JSON next to {output_stem}. Adjust paths to your build.

import.description: Skip transcription entirely and use a transcript you already have. Override the path per run with --transcript.
